Activity.description: A deposit, swap or withdrawal. Returned by history, by the status endpoints and as every message of the live streams. Fields that don't apply to a type are omitted; fields not known yet are null.

amount.description: Withdrawals: what arrives at `destination`, after `fee`. Deposits: what was credited to your balance.
Decimal string in whole units (not atomic).

chainId.description: The other chain involved: where a swap's token trades, where a withdrawal goes, where a deposit came from. 900 is Solana.

completedAt.description: When it finished. Null while pending.

destination.description: Withdrawals: the address on `chainId` that receives the funds.

explorerUrl.description: `txHash` on that chain's block explorer, or null without a `txHash`.

fee.description: Swaps: GUM's trading fee, in USD, or null until the swap completes: the fee is only charged then, and a swap that fails is refunded in full. Withdrawals: the network fee in the withdrawn token, already taken out of `amount`.

amount.description: Decimal string in whole units (not atomic).

final.description: True once nothing can change: stop polling or listening. A failed swap stays false until its funds are back and it turns `refunded`.

id.description: The request's account on GUM Network (base58); a swap that settles in one transaction uses its transaction id. Use it with the status endpoints.

pay.description: Swaps: what left your balance: USD on a buy, the token on a sell.

amount.description: Decimal string in whole units (not atomic).

reason.description: Why it failed, when `status` is failed.

receive.description: Swaps: what reached your balance. `amount` is null until the swap fills.

amount.description: Decimal string in whole units (not atomic).

side.description: buy spends USD on `token`; sell turns `token` into USD.

status.description: pending → completed, or failed (swaps that fail are refunded automatically and later read `refunded`). Withdrawals can also end `cancelled`.

step.description: Human-readable progress while pending, e.g. "Executing swap on Solana".

token.description: The token involved, as on its home chain. USD has no address; a USD withdrawal shows the dollar token it pays out.

txHash.description: The transaction on `chainId`: the swap, the withdrawal's payout or the deposit. Null until there is one.

perpsUsd.description: GUM Perps balance in USD, or null when it can't be read right now.

tokens.description: Everything you hold besides USD, largest first.

usd.description: Cash you can spend on buys.

usdWithdrawable.description: False on chains with their own dollar token (BSC, Robinhood) and on chains whose withdrawals haven't opened yet.

depositAddress.description: Send funds here, on this chain.

status.description: healthy; degraded (slower than usual); down (don't send now); unknown.

minimumUsd.description: Smaller deposits wait until the total sent to the address reaches it.

DollarToken.description: The dollar token GUM credits and pays out on a chain.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on the message.

dryRun.description: Check the signature without submitting. Nothing is sent or charged.

signature.description: Your wallet's signature of the quote's `message` bytes. Solana: the 64-byte Ed25519 signature as base58, base64 or hex. EVM: the 0x hex string from personal_sign / signMessage over the raw bytes.

address.description: The GUM account that signs: a Solana wallet's public key, or an EVM wallet's typed address (tag 0x10).

signWith.description: solana: Ed25519 over the raw `message` bytes; the API adds it as typed signature 0x00. evm: personal_sign (EIP-191) over the raw `message` bytes; the API recovers your public key and adds typed signature 0x10.

id.description: Track it at statusUrl or eventsUrl.

transactionId.description: The GUM Network transaction that recorded the request.

amount.description: Decimal string in whole units (not atomic).

message.description: The Solana legacy message inside `transaction`, base64. Sign these bytes with your wallet, as `signer.signWith` says.

minimum.description: Guaranteed on-chain; the trade fails rather than fill below it.

info.description:
Trade on GUM with a Solana or EVM wallet. Your wallet is your account: there is nothing to sign up for and no API key.

Every write is two calls: get a quote, sign its `message` with your wallet, then submit `{ transaction, signature }`. Track the returned `id` with the status endpoint or its live stream.

`transaction` is in GUM's wire format: typed signature records, then the Solana legacy message that `message` holds. You never build a record: send your wallet's plain signature and the API adds it as a typed signature.

Amounts are decimal strings in whole units ("25" is $25; "0.5" is half a token). USD is GUM's cash balance.

Per IP, per minute:
- 120 all requests
- 10 deposit-address lookups
- 30 quotes
- 20 submitted swaps and withdrawals
- 10 open live streams

Docs: https://docs.gum.ag/trading-api/overview
